## Change summary

Describe the learner, content, design or platform change.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run validate` passes
- [ ] Registration, enrolment and sign-in links are correct
- [ ] No protected course material or learner data is committed publicly
- [ ] Mobile layout has been checked
- [ ] Keyboard navigation and focus states have been checked
- [ ] Metadata, sitemap and canonical domain remain correct
- [ ] Screenshots are attached for visual changes
- [ ] Intellectual-property and attribution requirements are satisfied

## Risk and rollback

Describe deployment risk, compatibility impact and rollback steps.
